```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import zscore

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func(data_matrix):
    data = np.asarray(data_matrix, dtype=float)

    if data.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("data_matrix must be a 2D matrix.")
    if data.shape[0] == 0 or data.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("data_matrix must not be empty.")

    z_values = zscore(data, axis=1, nan_policy="propagate")

    feature_cols = [f"Feature {i + 1}" for i in range(data.shape[1])]
    z_df = pd.DataFrame(z_values, columns=feature_cols)
    z_df["Mean"] = z_df.mean(axis=1)

    corr_matrix = z_df[feature_cols].corr()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, ax=ax, cmap="viridis", annot=False, square=True)
    ax.set_title("Correlation Matrix of Z-values")

    return z_df, ax
```
